sloka: तथा तु करुणं तस्य द्विजस्य परिदेवनम् ।शुश्राव राघवः सर्वं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् ।। ७.७४.१ ॥
transliteration: tathā tu karuṇaṁ tasya dvijasya paridevanam ।śuśrāva rāghavaḥ sarvaṁ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam ।। 7.74.1 ॥

translations.english: Rama heard the entire piteous lamentation of that brahmin, which was filled with sorrow and grief.
